name: Bloodmage Excision on the action bar is saved as Hemal Excision (#5469)
contract: AscensionBloodmageSecondary.cpp:604-611 (aura_ascension_bloodmage_hemal_excision::Offer): when Hemal Excision 803681 siphons curses from an ally, the caster gains the ten-second window 803734, whose apply learns Excision 803733 with learnSpell(803733, true) (PLAYERSPELL_TEMPORARY, never written to character_spell) and calls SetTemporarySpellReplacement(803681, 803733). The window's removal (line 619) clears it. A button holding Excision 803733 was saved by Player::_SaveActions as 803733; Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before any window learns it again, so IsActionButtonDataValid would refuse and delete it. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes: the Excision button must be saved as Hemal Excision 803681, and a button holding Hemal Excision itself must be saved unchanged. Fixture curses copied from bloodmage-hemal-excision-reactivation.json.

steps.label: Hemal Excision siphons the ally's curses
Hemal Excision is replaced by Excision
The Excision button is saved as Hemal Excision
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
